name: Stellar Content Studio for WooCommerce
author: ibrahimelhaddad

sections.description:
Stellar Content Studio writes product descriptions and SEO content for your WooCommerce store automatically, using your product photos and AI. You don’t need your own AI API key or any technical setup — the free plan runs on a limited number of generations per month, and the Pro plan runs invisibly through our own servers.

Features

  • Generate Descriptions — bilingual (or single-language) long/short product descriptions plus an SEO focus keyword, generated from the product name and photos.
  • SEO Tuning — bulk-edit SEO title, meta description, focus keyword (Rank Math), and image alt text across your entire catalog. Free rule-based suggestions always available; AI-written suggestions on Pro.
  • Word Preferences — a free-text list of store-specific word choices the AI always follows (e.g. preferred product terminology in any language).
  • Translation-plugin aware — detects and works with WPML, Polylang, or TranslatePress, or degrades cleanly to English-only single-language mode if none is active.
  • Brand voice & tone controls — formal/casual tone, and for Arabic stores, a فصحى/عامية register choice with a dialect picker (Egyptian, Gulf, Levantine, Maghrebi).

Free vs. Pro

The free plan includes a limited number of generations per month using a single resized product photo. Pro plans (subscription or one-time credit packs) unlock full-resolution multi-photo generations and AI-written SEO suggestions. See the plugin’s pricing page from the Settings screen for current plans.

External services

This plugin connects to our own backend service in order to generate product descriptions and SEO content. When you use the Generate Descriptions or AI-powered SEO Tuning features, the product name, product type, and the product photos you choose to include are sent from your site to our backend server, which forwards them to Anthropic’s Claude API (https://www.anthropic.com) to generate the content, and returns the result to your site. The generated content and your word-preference settings are retained on our server so they remain available in your plugin dashboard and to enforce your plan’s usage quota; no other product data is retained beyond that.

This only happens when you actively click Generate or request an AI SEO suggestion — nothing is sent automatically or in the background.

  • Anthropic (Claude API): https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
  • Stellar Content Studio backend: https://stellarmedialabs.com/bayan-ai-privacy-policy/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/stellar-content-studio-for-woocommerce, or install directly through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the new Stellar Content Studio menu to configure brand voice, tone, and word preferences.
  4. Open any product and use Generate Descriptions, or run SEO Tuning in bulk from the Stellar Content Studio menu.
sections.faq:
Do I need my own AI/API key?

No. Our backend handles the AI connection for you — you never need to sign up for or manage a separate AI API key.

What happens when I use up my free quota?

Generate Descriptions and AI SEO suggestions will pause until your quota resets (free plan) or you upgrade to a paid plan. The free rule-based SEO suggestions remain available regardless of quota.

Does this work with WPML / Polylang / TranslatePress?

Yes. Stellar Content Studio detects whichever multilingual plugin is active and adapts automatically. If none is active, it runs in English-only single-language mode.

Is my product data sent anywhere?

Only the product name, type, and the photos you choose are sent to our backend to generate content, and only when you click Generate. See “External services” above for details.
sections.changelog:
2.0.0

  • Renamed to Stellar Content Studio for WooCommerce throughout (plugin name, slug, and text domain).
  • SEO Tuning screen’s admin script is now properly enqueued via wp_enqueue_script()/wp_localize_script() instead of an inline script block.
  • Lengthened internal function/option prefixes for WordPress.org compliance.

1.9.0

  • Word Preferences now has its own screen with a simple “use this word / instead of that” editor — no need to write text rules by hand (still fully compatible with any custom rules already saved).
  • Removed the internal “Model” field from Settings — not something a store owner needs to configure.

1.8.0

  • Added Word Preferences setting — store-specific word-choice rules applied to the AI’s output.

1.7.0

  • Proper English-only single-language-store mode (no wasted generations on unusable translations).

1.6.0

  • Added TranslatePress support.
  • Review screen now follows the store’s configured language.

1.5.0

  • Multilingual-plugin-agnostic translation dispatcher; added Polylang support.

1.4.3

  • Added Translation settings: tone, فصحى/عامية register, and dialect picker.

1.4.2

  • Removed internal branding; generic default brand-voice fallback.

1.4.1

  • SEO Tuning: alt text suggestion and save (built-in and AI).

1.4.0

  • Merged in SEO Tuning as a tab.

1.3.0

  • Renamed to Bayan AI throughout; added activation redirect.

1.2.0

  • Free plan uses one resized photo per generation; Pro uses up to six full-size photos.
